check: calibration documents vs evaluation sets: shared word runs and whole-text sha256

parameters.normalisation: str.split() on whitespace; case, punctuation and digits kept; shingle = n words joined by one space (same as kva checks/t02/overlap.py); JSON/JSONL: every string value is one text, a record is one item; .txt whole; token-id prompts decoded with the GGUF vocabulary
parameters.shingle_match: hash of the joined shingle; the longest shared run is measured word for word from 13-shingle anchors (exact for runs of >= 13 words)
parameters.sha256: UTF-8 SHA-256 of each calibration text vs each evaluation text (string value or decoded prompt) and each evaluation file's bytes
parameters.shared_counts: distinct shingles shared by the calibration document and the item (all its texts)

gguf_vocab_fingerprint.rule: sha256 of every token string followed by one NUL byte
